text.zh-CN:
中耳炎发生在鼓膜后方，常见于儿童，可造成耳痛和暂时听不清。

- 中耳通过细小通道与鼻后方相连，感冒后通道不畅可积液。
- 幼儿不一定会说耳痛，可能拉耳、哭闹或睡不好。
- 耳痛也可能来自外耳，检查位置决定处理方法。
text.en:
Otitis media affects the space behind the eardrum, often causing pain and muffled hearing in children.

- A small passage connects it to the back of the nose; blockage can leave fluid.
- Young children may pull an ear, cry or sleep poorly.
- Outer-ear pain needs different assessment.

text.zh-CN:
常与呼吸道感染和引流不畅有关。

- 感冒等感染可影响连接鼻咽与中耳的通道。
- 积液会影响声音传递，因此可能暂时听不清。
- 儿童更常见，接触烟雾等环境因素也应在评估时说明。
text.en:
Respiratory infection and impaired drainage often contribute.

- Colds can affect the passage connecting the nose and middle ear.
- Fluid interferes with sound transmission.
- Children are more often affected; smoke exposure is relevant context.

text.zh-CN:
伴随全身或耳周异常时要及时就医。

- 耳周明显肿胀、高热或全身很不舒服，应尽快评估。
- 新出现听力下降、持续流液或明显眩晕，不能只继续滴药。
- 幼儿精神差、进食饮水明显减少时，应及时寻求帮助。
text.en:
Seek prompt care for important changes.

- Swelling around the ear, high fever or marked illness needs assessment.
- New hearing loss, drainage or significant dizziness needs review.
- A child who is unusually unwell or barely drinking also needs help.

text.zh-CN:
年龄和病程影响处理安排。

- 一岁以下婴儿疑似耳感染，应由专业人员评估。
- 耳痛超过约三天不改善，或反复出现，应复诊。
- 免疫功能低下、糖尿病或其他严重慢病患者，应更早咨询。
text.en:
Age and progression influence care.

- Suspected infection in an infant under one year needs professional assessment.
- Pain persisting beyond about three days or recurring needs review.
- Reduced immunity, diabetes or major chronic illness warrants earlier advice.

text.zh-CN:
医生需要看清鼓膜和耳道。

- 耳镜是带灯和放大镜的工具，用来观察耳内。
- 检查帮助判断感染在中耳还是外耳，以及是否存在积液。
- 仅凭拉耳或耳痛不能确定中耳炎，也不能决定是否需要抗生素。
text.en:
The eardrum and ear canal need examination.

- An otoscope uses a light and magnification to inspect the ear.
- The examination helps distinguish middle-ear disease, outer-ear disease and fluid.
- Ear pulling or pain alone cannot determine the diagnosis or antibiotic need.

text.zh-CN:
相似症状可能涉及不同部位。

- 外耳道炎影响耳道皮肤，治疗和中耳炎不完全相同。
- 中耳积液可影响听力，但并不总代表急性感染仍在持续。
- 明显眩晕或耳周肿胀提示需要更广泛检查。
text.en:
Similar symptoms can involve different structures.

- Outer-ear infection affects the canal and may need different treatment.
- Residual middle-ear fluid can impair hearing without an ongoing acute infection.
- Dizziness or surrounding swelling requires broader assessment.

text.zh-CN:
治疗取决于年龄、严重程度和检查。

- 部分发作可自行改善，观察期间仍需处理疼痛和留意恶化。
- 严重感染或小婴儿可能需要抗生素，由医生决定。
- 反复感染或积液影响听力时，可讨论耳鼻喉评估和通气管等方案。
text.en:
Treatment depends on age, severity and examination.

- Some episodes improve without antibiotics, while pain and progression still need attention.
- Severe cases or young infants may require antibiotics.
- Recurrent infection or fluid-related hearing problems may need ENT assessment.

text.zh-CN:
不要把所有耳药当成通用滴耳液。

- 止痛药需采用适龄制剂，儿童不能直接使用成人方案。
- 抗生素是否需要取决于本次情况，不使用上次剩药。
- 鼓膜和感染部位影响滴耳药选择；减充血剂和抗组胺药不能可靠治疗中耳炎。
- 若使用抗生素，可能出现恶心或腹泻；呼吸困难、咽喉紧或口舌肿胀可能是严重过敏，应立即求助。
text.en:
Ear medicines are not interchangeable.

- Pain relief needs age-appropriate products and instructions.
- Antibiotics depend on this episode rather than a previous prescription.
- Eardrum status affects drops; decongestants and antihistamines do not reliably treat middle-ear infection.
- When antibiotics are used, nausea or diarrhoea may occur; breathing difficulty, throat tightness or mouth or tongue swelling may signal a serious allergy and need immediate help.

text.zh-CN:
饮食护理以维持摄入为主，不能直接清除中耳感染。

- 疼痛或发热期间维持能够接受的正常饮食与饮水。
- 孩子持续不愿喝水或进食明显减少，应评估病情。
text.en:
Dietary care focuses on maintaining intake; it cannot clear a middle-ear infection.

- Continue tolerated food and fluids during pain or fever.
- Persistent refusal to drink or feed needs assessment.

text.zh-CN:
居家护理以舒适和保护耳部为主。

- 只清洁流到耳外的分泌物，不用棉签或手指深入耳道。
- 感染期间避免让水和洗发水进入耳内，先暂停游泳。
- 观察体温、疼痛、听力和精神状态，记录变化便于复诊。
text.en:
Home care focuses on comfort and ear protection.

- Wipe drainage from outside rather than inserting cotton buds or fingers.
- Keep water and shampoo out and pause swimming during infection.
- Observe pain, temperature, hearing and general behaviour.

text.zh-CN:
婴幼儿与有基础病者需要更谨慎观察。

- 婴儿可能仅表现为烦躁、睡不好或喂养变差。
- 免疫功能减弱者或糖尿病患者，症状恶化时应及早就医。
- 反复听不清的儿童，应讨论听力及语言交流方面的影响。
text.en:
Some people need closer observation.

- Infants may show irritability, poor sleep or feeding changes.
- Reduced immunity or diabetes calls for early care when worsening.
- Children repeatedly struggling to hear may need hearing and communication assessment.

text.zh-CN:
疼痛改善不等于所有问题同时恢复。

- 多数急性耳感染会在数日内好转，但恢复时间不同。
- 听力持续下降、反复流液或再次发热，应复查耳部。
- 反复发作时随访要关注听力和积液，而不仅记录疼痛。
text.en:
Pain and hearing do not always recover together.

- Many acute ear infections improve within days, with variable recovery.
- Persistent hearing loss, drainage or renewed fever requires review.
- Recurrent episodes need attention to hearing and fluid, not pain alone.

text.zh-CN:
持续或反复问题可能影响听力。

- 中耳积液可让声音传递变差，出现暂时听力下降。
- 反复感染可能需要进一步治疗或耳鼻喉评估。
- 耳周肿胀或全身明显不适可能提示更严重问题，应及时处理。
text.en:
Persistent or recurrent problems may affect hearing.

- Fluid can reduce sound transmission and temporarily impair hearing.
- Repeated infection may need further ENT treatment.
- Surrounding swelling or marked illness may indicate a more serious problem.

text.zh-CN:
预防可以减少部分风险。

- 按当地安排完成儿童疫苗接种。
- 让儿童远离烟雾环境，注意减少呼吸道感染传播。
- 不要往耳道里塞棉签等物品；感冒相关中耳炎仍可能发生。
text.en:
Prevention reduces some risks.

- Keep childhood immunisations up to date locally.
- Avoid smoke exposure and reduce spread of respiratory infections.
- Keep objects out of the ear canal; cold-related middle-ear infections can still occur.
